title: NPDev Seed/Mock Data File
description: AppGen-authoring-only convention (definition/seeds/<id>.json), consumed at build time by Build-NpdevApp.ps1 and at runtime by SeedDataService/DataSeedAdminController. Not seen by the model compiler.

id.description: Stable identifier, must match the filename stem (definition/seeds/<id>.json).

kind.description: 'smart' resolves $ref:alias placeholders and expands repeatOver blocks before saving. 'raw' saves every record exactly as written and rejects alias/repeatOver/$ref: usage at load time.

allOf.description: Bulk-generated (repeatOver) rows can't be individually aliased.
Bulk-generated (count) rows can't be individually aliased.
repeatOver and count are two alternative bulk-generation mechanisms -- use only one.
Either bulk mechanism needs 'data' as the per-row template.

concept.description: Concept name exactly as declared in model.json (matches the generic CRUD REST path's underlying concept, e.g. 'Produto').

alias.description: smart kind only. Optional local name a later record's data can reference via "$ref:<alias>". Only single (non-bulk) records may carry an alias.

id.description: raw kind only. Explicit id for this record; if omitted the runner generates one.

data.description: Field values, same shape as a POST /api/<concept> body. In 'smart' mode: a string value of the exact form "$ref:<alias>" is replaced with that alias's generated id; a string value of the form "$gen:<generator>[:<args>]" is replaced with a value from one of the built-in generators below (R3.2). Both are resolved on top-level fields only. 'raw' seeds reject both forms outright -- raw doesn't template.

repeatOver.description: smart kind only. Bulk-generates one record per combination of the declared integer ranges (Cartesian product). Mutually exclusive with 'count' and 'alias'.

count.description: smart kind only (R3.2). Shorthand for repeatOver with no index variables: bulk-generates this many copies of 'data'. Meant to pair with $gen:* tokens for per-row randomized values rather than $var substitution. Mutually exclusive with 'repeatOver' and 'alias'.

genToken.description: R3.2 -- not referenced by $ref anywhere (documentation only: 'data' values are untyped, so JSON Schema cannot itself express a conditional string-pattern-to-semantics mapping over a free-form object). The six built-in $gen:<generator>[:<args>] value tokens a 'smart' seed's 'data' fields may use, resolved against one Random per run seeded by the seed's own id (so two runs of the same seed produce identical generated values):
genToken.$comment: $gen:name -- a two-word person name from a small built-in corpus. | $gen:words[:<count>] -- <count> space-joined words from a small built-in corpus, default count 5. | $gen:date-range:<minIso>:<maxIso> -- an ISO date (yyyy-MM-dd) uniformly drawn from the inclusive range. | $gen:decimal-range:<min>:<max> -- a decimal uniformly drawn from the inclusive range, scale matched to the more precise of min/max (minimum 2). | $gen:enum-pick:<v1>,<v2>,... -- one of the comma-separated literal values, chosen at random. | $gen:ref-pick-random:<concept> -- a random id among that concept's records already saved earlier in THIS seed run (like $ref:<alias>, the referent concept's records must be declared earlier in the file's 'records' array; fails with a named error, not a silent empty pick, if none have been saved yet).
